newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade brisk $106/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade brisk $106/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderately active on Wednesday morning, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not established on a live basis, dressed basis sales steady with Tuesday's decline.

Buyer inquiry good, seller interest moderate. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights) Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1275 lbs 105.00-106.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 105.00-106.00.
